caption:
Costa Rica generates over 99 percent of its electricity from renewable sources. Traveling through the mountain passes can be as quiet as the cloud forest itself — no engine clatter, no exhaust, just headlights sweeping over the wet gravel and the canopy settling into the dark. Luxury travel in Costa Rica is learning how to move through fragile places without leaving a wake.
